title: Debating Ethical Dilemmas / Debatɛ kɔbɔ ndɔmbɛ ya mɪ̌kɛ̌ngɛ̌ ya etikɛ
bridge: Na espanyole, po na kosalela debatɛ, tolingaka na kosalela temps ya subjonctif na nsuka ya mɛsɛ́nganyɛ. Na anglɛ, subjonctif ezali molongo; indicatif to indicatif na ba structures ya modalité ezali mpo na kopesa. Mɔkɔlɔ, 'no creo que sea correcto' ezali 'I don't think it is right' (kasi 'it be right'). Kɛlɛ, kosalela 'should' na 'would' po na ba conseils na ba conditionnels ezali na nguya ya kopɛsa na espanyole, kote tosalaka na kosalela conditionnel simple. Kolanda na likolo na ba adverbes na bobelemi ya kopɛsa double négation na anglɛ.
rule: Po na kosalela debatɛ na anglɛ na niveau B2, kosalela: 1) 'I think/ believe/ feel' + clause na indicatif: 'I think that...' (kasi subjonctif). 2) Ba modaux: 'should' (recommandation), 'ought to' (formel), 'must' (obligation forte), 'can't' (impossibilité), 'could' (possibilité), 'would' (hypothèse). 3) Ba structures ya accord/désaccord: 'I agree with... because...', 'I see your point, but...', 'That may be true, however...'. 4) Ba conditionnels po na ba hypothèses éthiques: 'If we allowed... , then...' (premier conditionnel), 'If I were in that situation, I would...' (deuxième conditionnel). 5) Ba connecteurs: 'therefore', 'moreover', 'nevertheless', 'although'. Boya double négation ('I don't agree with nothing' ezali malonga) na kosalela inversion po na kopɛsa: 'Not only is it unethical, but also...'.

concept_examples.text: I believe that animal testing is unethical because it causes unnecessary suffering.
concept_examples.translation: Nakoki koloba ete ba essais kɔbɔ ba animaux ezali na etikɛ mɔkɔlɔ mpo ezali na kopesa souffrance ya mɔkɔlɔ.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ bɪˈliːv ðæt ˈænɪməl ˈtestɪŋ ɪz ʌnˈeθɪkəl bɪˈkɔːz ɪt ˈkɔːzɪz ʌnˈnesəseri ˈsʌfərɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: If I were in that situation, I would tell the truth, even if it was difficult.
concept_examples.translation: Soki nazali na yango situation, nakokaki koloba bomoyi, ata soki ezali makasi.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːr ɪn ðæt ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən, aɪ wʊd tɛl ðə truːθ, ˈiːvən ɪf ɪt wʌz ˈdɪfɪkəlt/

concept_examples.text: Some people argue that genetically modified crops are necessary to feed the world, but others disagree.
concept_examples.translation: Ba monsɛ́ngi ya mɔkɔlɔ basalaka ete ba cultures ya OGM ezali na nguya po na kopesa mɛngi na mokili, kasi bangá basalaka ndenge mɛ́ngá.
concept_examples.phonetic: /sʌm ˈpiːpəl ˈɑːrɡjuː ðæt dʒəˈnetɪkli ˈmɒdɪfaɪd krɒps ɑːr ˈnesəseri tuː fiːd ðə wɜːrld, bʌt ˈʌðərz ˌdɪsəˈɡriː/

concept_examples.text: We shouldn't sacrifice privacy for security; both are essential.
concept_examples.translation: Asookana tokoki kosala sacrifice ya privacité po na sécurité; mibale ezali ya nguya.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː ˈʃʊdnt ˈsækrɪfaɪs ˈpraɪvəsi fɔːr sɪˈkjʊrəti; boʊθ ɑːr ɪˈsenʃəl/

common_error.wrong: I don't think that it is not ethical to lie.
common_error.correct: I don't think it is ethical to lie.
common_error.correct_alt: I think it is unethical to lie.
common_error.explanation: Nkɔbama ezali mpo na espanyole ezali molongo na kosalela double négation ('No creo que no sea ético'), kasi na anglɛ phrase mobimba ekoki kozala na bobelemi mɔkɔ ya négation. Po na kopɛsa yango, boya 'not' mosúsu to boyeka na kosalela mot ya contraire (unethical).

examples.original: In my opinion, we should recycle more.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ əˈpɪnjən, wiː ʃʊd ˌriːˈsaɪkəl mɔːr/
examples.translation: Na avis na ngai, tokoki kosala recyclage mpenza.
examples.note: Kosalela 'in my opinion' na libonga po na kopɛsa avis na yo.

examples.original: I strongly believe that every child deserves a quality education.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈstrɔŋli bɪˈliːv ðæt ˈɛvri tʃaɪld dɪˈzɜːrvz ə ˈkwɒləti ˌɛdʒuˈkeɪʃən/
examples.translation: Nakoki koloba na makasi ete mokɔmɔ mobimba akoki kozala na éducation ya qualité.
examples.note: Adverbe 'strongly' ekoki kozala libonga na verbe principal 'believe'.

examples.original: From my perspective, this policy has more benefits than drawbacks.
examples.phonetic: /frɒm maɪ pərˈspɛktɪv, ðɪs ˈpɒləsi hæz mɔːr ˈbɛnɪfɪts ðæn ˈdrɔːbæks/
examples.translation: Na point ya vue na ngai, politique oyo ezali na ba avantages mpenza koleka ba désavantages.
examples.note: Boyeka traduction ya mot à mot 'Bajo mi punto de vista'.

examples.original: I couldn't agree more with your argument about renewable energy.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkʊdnt əˈɡriː mɔːr wɪð jɔːr ˈɑːrɡjumənt əˈbaʊt rɪˈnjuːəbl ˈɛnərdʒi/
examples.translation: Nazali na accord mpenza na argument ya yo kɔbɔ énergie ya recyclage.
examples.note: Expression oyo eleki koloba accord total. Boyeka na kosalela 'I can't agree' (nazali na désaccord).

examples.original: I see your point, but I think there are other factors to consider.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ siː jɔːr pɔɪnt, bʌt aɪ θɪŋk ðeər ɑːr ˈʌðər ˈfæktərz tuː kənˈsɪdər/
examples.translation: Nakoki kosala point ya yo, kasi nakoki koloba ete ezali ba facteurs mosúsu ya kolandá.
examples.note: Mɛ́ngá ya kosalela désaccord na ndenge ya mɛ́ngá.

examples.original: That may be true, however, we must also think about the long-term effects.
examples.phonetic: /ðæt meɪ biː truː, haʊˈɛvər, wiː mʌst ˈɔːlsoʊ θɪŋk əˈbaʊt ðə ˈlɔːŋtɜːrm ɪˈfɛkts/
examples.translation: Yango ekoki kozala bomoyi, kasi, tokoki kosala réflexion kɔbɔ ba effets ya long terme.
examples.note: Kosalela 'however' na nsuka ya pause ya virgule.

examples.original: If the government banned all private cars, the air quality would improve significantly.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt bænd ɔːl ˈpraɪvɪt kɑːrz, ðiː ɛər ˈkwɒləti wʊd ɪmˈpruːv sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli/
examples.translation: Soki gouvernement ekɔtɛ́laka ba voitures privées nyonso, qualité ya air ekokaki kosala amélioration ya mɔkɔlɔ.
examples.note: Deuxième conditionnel po na ba situations ya probabilité mɔkɔ to ya hypothèse. Na anglɛ, kosalela 'were' na esika 'was' ezali.

examples.original: If I were the CEO, I would prioritize employee well-being over profits.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːr ðə ˌsiː.iːˈoʊ, aɪ wʊd praɪˈɔːrɪtaɪz ˌɛmplɔɪˈiː ˌwɛlˈbiːɪŋ ˈoʊvər ˈprɒfɪts/
examples.translation: Soki nazalaki directeur général, nakokaki kopɛsa bien-être ya ba employés libonga koleka ba bénéfices.
examples.note: Kosalela ya bomoyi ya 'were' na subjonctif passé. Ba parlants ya espanyole mɔkɔ basalaka 'I was'.

examples.original: What would you do if you found a wallet with a thousand dollars inside?
examples.phonetic: /wʌt wʊd juː duː ɪf juː faʊnd ə ˈwɔːlɪt wɪð ə ˈθaʊzənd ˈdɒlərz ɪnˈsaɪd?/
examples.translation: Olingi kosala nini soki okutanaki portefeuille na mille dollars na ndɔ́kɔ?
examples.note: Structure ya question na conditionnel: auxiliaire 'would' na libonga.

examples.original: If we don't act now, future generations will suffer the consequences.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː doʊnt ækt naʊ, ˈfjuːtʃər ˌdʒɛnəˈreɪʃənz wɪl ˈsʌfər ðə ˈkɒnsɪkwɛnsɪz/
examples.translation: Soki tokosala rien maintenant, ba générations ya nsuka bakokaki kosala ba conséquences.
examples.note: Premier conditionnel po na ba situations ya réalité na probabilité.

title: Strategic Language for Negotiations / Mbotosi ya stratéji po kosolola
bridge: Na espanyolí, tokosala na mpo na nkombo ya subjonctif po kosala mabotosi malamu ("quisiera", "me gustaría"), kasi na ngala, basali ba modaux bakomí "would", "could" mpe "might" po kosala mosala moko, kasi na esika mosusu. Kasi na ntina, bato oyo basoli espanyolí bazali kosala molongo mpe na kozwa epaya ya moloba, kasi na ngala, tokoki koloba "no" na nzela moke mpe na mabotosi oyo ezali malamu, lokola "I'm afraid" to "unfortunately". Boye mpe, tokoki kozwa "de acuerdo" na esika ya "I am agree" - kasi na yango, motuna ezali "agree" mpe tokoki kosala yango mpo na kozwa esika ya "to be".
rule: Na kosolola na ngala na niveau B2, tokosala na modaux po koloba mabotosi mpe makasi (would, could, might, may). Bisaleli oyo ezali malamu lokola "I would suggest..." to "We could consider..." ezali malamu mpe na esika ya "I want..." to "You must...". Po kozwa epaya ya moloba, tokosala "What if..." to "How about..." mpe tokosala na gerund to na clause. Po kozwa epaya ya moloba na nzela ya diplomatie, tokosala mabotosi oyo ezali malamu lokola "I see your point, but..." to "I'm afraid that...". Na kosolola na makasi, tokosala na conditonnel (If... then...). Boye mpe, na ngala, "agree" ezali motuna, kasi ezali mpe mpe tokoki kosala yango mpo na kozwa esika ya "to be", lokóasa tokoki koloba "I am agree" kasi "I agree".

concept_examples.text: I would suggest we postpone the deadline to next week.
concept_examples.translation: Nakoki koloba ete topesa date ya mbula mosusu tii na liboso.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd səˈdʒɛst wi poʊstˈpoʊn ðə ˈdɛdlaɪn tu nɛkst wik/

concept_examples.text: We could consider a discount if you increase the order volume.
concept_examples.translation: Tokoki kosala mokano ya kozwa mokano moke soki bozali koluka kopesa mokano moke.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wi kʊd kənˈsɪdər ə ˈdɪskaʊnt ɪf ju ˈɪnkris ðə ˈɔrdər ˈvɑljum/

concept_examples.text: I'm afraid that price is a bit higher than we expected.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali na elikya ete mokano oyo ezali mpenza moke mpe ezali moke mpe na esika ya mokano oyo tozali kozwa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪm əˈfreɪd ðæt praɪs ɪz ə bɪt ˈhaɪər ðæn wi ɪkˈspɛktɪd/

concept_examples.text: What if we split the difference and meet in the middle?
concept_examples.translation: Ndenge nini soki tokokanisa mokano mpe tokokana na esika ya mokano?
concept_examples.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf wi splɪt ðə ˈdɪfərəns ænd mit ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl/

common_error.wrong: I am agree with your proposal, but we need a better price.
common_error.correct: I agree with your proposal, but we need a better price.
common_error.correct_alt: I completely agree with your proposal, but we would need a better price.
common_error.explanation: Likolo oyo ezali na esika ya kozwa esika ya espanyolí, tokosala "estoy de acuerdo" (tokosala na motuna "estar" mpe na nkombo), mpe tokoki kozwa yango na esika ya ngala lokola "I am agree". Na ngala, "agree" ezali motuna ya solo, kasi ezali mpe mpe tokoki kosala yango mpo na kozwa esika ya "to be". Po kozwa esika ya likolo oyo, boye mpe, tokoki kosala "agree" mpe tokoki kosala yango mpo na kozwa esika ya "coincidir" to "estar de acuerdo" kasi tokoki kosala yango mpo na kozwa esika ya "be". Kasi na yango, tokoki mpe kosala mabotosi oyo ezali malamu lokola "completely" to "partially" po kozwa esika ya makasi.

examples.original: I would like to propose a different approach.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tə prəˈpoʊz ə ˈdɪfərənt əˈproʊtʃ/
examples.translation: Nakoki koloba ete nazali na elikya ya kozwa esika ya mokano mosusu.
examples.note: Sala "would like to" po kozwa esika ya mabotosi mpe ya malamu, oyo ezali mpe na esika ya "quisiera" na espanyolí kasi tokoki kosala yango mpo na kozwa esika ya subjonctif.

examples.original: How about meeting next Tuesday?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ əˈbaʊt ˈmitɪŋ nɛkst ˈtuzdeɪ/
examples.translation: Ndenge nini soki tokokana na liboso ya mwa ya moke?
examples.note: "How about" mpe tokosala na gerund ezali nzela ya kozwa esika ya mabotosi. Tokoki kozwa yango na esika ya mabotosi.

examples.original: I suggest we revisit the terms of the contract.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ səˈdʒɛst wi riˈvɪzɪt ðə tɜrmz əv ðə ˈkɑntrækt/
examples.translation: Nazali koyeba ete tokoki kozwa esika ya makano ya contrat.
examples.note: Na ngala, tokosala na subjonctif ya solo (mpe tokoki kosala yango mpo na kozwa esika ya "s" na esika ya motuna ya moke), oyo ezali mpe na esika ya subjonctif ya espanyolí.

levels.label: Expressing Disagreement Diplomatically
levels.translation: Kozwa epaya ya moloba na nzela ya diplomatie

examples.original: I see your point, but I have some concerns about the timeline.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ si jʊr pɔɪnt bʌt aɪ hæv sʌm kənˈsɜrnz əˈbaʊt ðə ˈtaɪmlaɪn/
examples.translation: Nazali koyeba epaya ya moloba ya yo, kasi nazali na biloko moke po kozwa epaya ya mokano.
examples.note: Bisaleli oyo ezali malamu epaya ya moloba mpe na kozwa epaya ya moloba ya motuna.

examples.original: I'm afraid that's not quite what we had in mind.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm əˈfreɪd ðæts nɑt kwaɪt wʌt wi hæd ɪn maɪnd/
examples.translation: Nazali na elikya ete ezali mpe na esika ya mokano oyo tozali kozwa.
examples.note: "I'm afraid" ezali mpe na esika ya kozwa epaya ya moloba kasi ezali mpe mpe na esika ya kozwa epaya ya moloba. Ezali mpe mpe na esika ya kozwa epaya ya moloba.

examples.original: I understand your position, but we would need more flexibility.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˌʌndərˈstænd jʊr pəˈzɪʃən bʌt wi wʊd nid mɔr ˌflɛksəˈbɪlɪti/
examples.translation: Nazali koyeba epaya ya moloba ya yo, kasi tokoki kozwa esika ya mokano moke.
examples.note: Sala "would need" na esika ya "need" po kozwa esika ya mokano mpe po kozwa esika ya kozwa epaya ya moloba.

levels.label: Negotiating Terms and Closing Deals
levels.translation: Kosolola makano mpe kozwa esika ya makano

examples.original: If you can offer a 10% discount, we would be willing to sign today.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ju kæn ˈɔfər ə tɛn pɜrˈsɛnt ˈdɪskaʊnt wi wʊd bi ˈwɪlɪŋ tə saɪn təˈdeɪ/
examples.translation: Soki bozali kozwa mokano ya 10%, tokoki kozwa esika ya kozwa esika ya makano yango lelo.
examples.note: Conditonnel na "if" mpe "would" po kozwa esika ya mokano ya mokano.

examples.original: Let's meet halfway on the shipping costs.
examples.phonetic: /lɛts mit ˈhæfweɪ ɒn ðə ˈʃɪpɪŋ kɔsts/
examples.translation: Tokoki kozwa esika ya kozwa esika ya mokano ya mokano ya mokano.
examples.note: "Meet halfway" ezali mpe na esika ya kozwa esika ya mokano ya mokano.

examples.original: We have a deal if you agree to these terms.
examples.phonetic: /wi hæv ə dil ɪf ju əˈgri tə ðiz tɜrmz/
examples.translation: Tokoki kozwa esika ya makano soki bozali kozwa esika ya makano oyo.
examples.note: Sala "a deal" na esika ya "an agreement" na mibali ya kozwa esika ya makano.

translations.ln: Mibali mpe kosolola na mikolo ya mosala

title: Discussing Literature and Film / Kozonga ntema ya bouk na film
bridge: Na anglais, po kozonga ntema ya bouk na film, tokosala ba phrases oyo ezali ndenge 'I found it...' to 'It struck me as...', oyo bazali na equivalent direct na espagnol, kasi tozali kosala 'me pareció' to 'me resultó'. Kasi, ba adjectifs ya opinion na anglais bazali koyokana na avant ya nom (a gripping novel), kasi na espagnol bazali koyokana na après (una novela apasionante). Mbeke moko ya kobanga ezali na l'utilisation ya temps verbaux na kozanga ba histoires: na anglais tokosala présent simple po kozanga ba histoires (the protagonist discovers...), kasi na espagnol tozali kosala présent to passé composé.
rule: Po kozonga ntema ya bouk na film na anglais na niveau B2, boye koleka: 1) Kozanga ba opinions na ba adjectifs na ba structures ndenge 'I found it + adjectif' (I found it thought-provoking) to 'It struck me as + adjectif' (It struck me as predictable). 2) Kozanga ba histoires na présent simple (The story follows a detective who uncovers a conspiracy). 3) Kosala passé simple po ba événements spécifiques (I read the book last year). 4) Kozanga ba comparaisons na 'unlike' to 'whereas' (Unlike the book, the film omits several key scenes). Ezali mpenza na ntina kosala 'based on' (The movie is based on a novel). Na vocabulaire, ba adjectifs ndenge 'gripping', 'thought-provoking', 'predictable', 'far-fetched', 'moving' bazali na ntina. Boye kozonga 'me pareció' ndenge 'it seemed to me' na ba cas nionso; kosala 'I thought' to 'I found'.

concept_examples.text: I found the novel gripping from the first page.
concept_examples.translation: Nakoti bouk oyo ezali ya motoya na page ya liboso.
concept_examples.phonetic: aɪ faʊnd ðə ˈnɒvəl ˈɡrɪpɪŋ frəm ðə fɜːst peɪdʒ.

concept_examples.text: The film is based on a true story.
concept_examples.translation: Film oyo ezali baser na histoire ya vrai.
concept_examples.phonetic: ðə fɪlm ɪz beɪst ɒn ə truː ˈstɔːri.

concept_examples.text: Unlike the book, the movie has a much faster pace.
concept_examples.translation: A différence ya bouk, film ezali na rythme mpenza ya vite.
concept_examples.phonetic: ʌnˈlaɪk ðə bʊk, ðə ˈmuːvi hæz ə mʌtʃ ˈfɑːstə peɪs.

concept_examples.text: The author uses symbolism to explore themes of identity.
concept_examples.translation: Auteur azali kosala ba symboles po kozala ba thèmes ya identité.
concept_examples.phonetic: ði ˈɔːθə juːzɪz ˈsɪmbəlɪzəm tuː ɪkˈsplɔː θiːmz ɒv aɪˈdentɪti.

common_error.wrong: The book is more interesting that the movie.
common_error.correct: The book is more interesting than the movie.
common_error.correct_alt: The book is more interesting compared to the movie.
common_error.explanation: Na anglais, po kozanga ba comparaisons, tokosala 'than' mpe na espagnol, bazali kosala 'que'. Ba lokuta ya espagnol bazali koyeba 'that' (que, relatif) na 'than' (que, comparatif). Boye koluka: soki ozali kozanga deux choses, kosala 'than'.

examples.original: I found the ending a bit predictable.
examples.phonetic: aɪ faʊnd ði ˈendɪŋ ə bɪt prɪˈdɪktəbəl.
examples.translation: Nakoti lisusu ya bouk ezali ya prédictible.
examples.note: Tosala 'I found + objet + adjectif' po kozanga ba opinions. Ezali mpenza na ndenge ya 'I think it was'.

examples.original: It struck me as a very thought-provoking film.
examples.phonetic: ɪt strʌk mi æz ə ˈveri ˈθɔːt prəˈvəʊkɪŋ fɪlm.
examples.translation: Nakoti film oyo ezali ya motoya mpenza.
examples.note: 'It struck me as' ezali une expression idiomatique po ba impressions personnelles.

examples.original: The dialogue felt really natural.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈdaɪəlɒɡ fɛlt ˈrɪəli ˈnætʃrəl.
examples.translation: Dialogue nakoti ezali ya naturel mpenza.
examples.note: Tosala 'feel' po kozanga ba perceptions subjectives.

examples.original: The story follows a young detective who uncovers a conspiracy.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈstɔːri ˈfɒləʊz ə jʌŋ dɪˈtɛktɪv huː ʌnˈkʌvəz ə kənˈspɪrəsi.
examples.translation: Histoire ezali koyoka jeune détective oyo akutanaka une conspiration.
examples.note: Tosala présent simple po kozanga histoire, ata soki histoire ezali na passé.

examples.original: In the end, the protagonist realizes the truth.
examples.phonetic: ɪn ði end, ðə prəˈtæɡənɪst ˈrɪəlaɪzɪz ðə truːθ.
examples.translation: Na lisusu, protagoniste akomi koyeba vérité.
examples.note: Tosala 'in the end' mpe na espagnol, bazali kosala 'al final' po kozanga lisusu ya histoire.

examples.original: The plot twists unexpectedly when the villain is revealed.
examples.phonetic: ðə plɒt twɪsts ʌnɪkˈspɛktɪdli wɛn ðə ˈvɪlən ɪz rɪˈviːld.
examples.translation: Histoire ezali koyoka une surprise soki villain akomataki.
examples.note: Présent simple ezali mpenza po kozanga ba surprises ya histoire.

examples.original: Whereas the book is very descriptive, the film relies on visual storytelling.
examples.phonetic: ˌweərˈæz ðə bʊk ɪz ˈveri dɪˈskrɪptɪv, ðə fɪlm rɪˈlaɪz ɒn ˈvɪʒuəl ˈstɔːritəlɪŋ.
examples.translation: Kasi bouk ezali ya descriptif mpenza, film ezali koyokana na narration visuelle.
examples.note: Tosala 'whereas' po kozanga deux idées. Na espagnol, bazali kosala 'mientras que'.

examples.original: The movie adaptation leaves out a lot of the subplots.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈmuːvi ˌædæpˈteɪʃən liːvz aʊt ə lɒt ɒv ðə ˈsʌbplɒts.
examples.translation: Adaptation ya film ezali koyoka ba sous-histoires mpenza.
examples.note: 'Leave out' eleki kozanga. Ezali mpenza na ba critiques ya adaptations.

examples.original: Unlike the original, the remake has a more optimistic ending.
examples.phonetic: ʌnˈlaɪk ði əˈrɪdʒɪnəl, ðə ˈriːmeɪk hæz ə mɔːr ˌɒptɪˈmɪstɪk ˈendɪŋ.
examples.translation: A différence ya original, remake ezali na lisusu ya plus optimiste.
examples.note: Tosala 'unlike' na libonga ya phrase po kozanga.

translations.ln: Kozonga ntema ya bouk na film

title: Discussing Health and Science News / Kozonga yango lokola lolendo ya bilanga mibeko ya sante na sayansi
bridge: Na espanyol, tozali kozonga yango lokola lolendo ya bilanga mibeko ya sayansi to mibeko ya medecin na temps présent ya indicatif, kasi na anglais ezali eloko ya mbeko mingi kozonga yango na temps présent parfait mpo na kobongisa mbula na temps présent ('Researchers have found...') to na temps passé simple mpo na mibeko ya makasi ('The study showed...'). Kosi na anglais, bazali kosalela mingi verbes modaux lokola 'may', 'might' to 'could' mpo na kozonga posibilité na makasi, kasi na espanyol tozali kosalela mingi 'puede' to mibeko ya ngala. Mbeke moko ya makasi ezali kozala na 'however' na 'although' mpo na kobongisa, oyo na espanyol ezali kozala na 'sin embargo' na 'aunque', kasi na mibeko ya ngala na position na phrase.
rule: Mpo na kozonga mibeko ya sayansi na medecin na anglais na niveau B2, boye kolinga kobonda yango: 1) Temps présent parfait mpo na kozonga résultat ya mbula moke na kobongisa na temps présent: 'Scientists have discovered a new vaccine' (Bazali kosengeli...), vs. temps passé simple mpo na mibeko ya makasi: 'The study was published in 2020'. 2) Voix passive mpo na kobimisa makasi na résultat to na action, te na agent: 'The drug is being tested' (Drogue ezali kosengeli). 3) Modaux ya posibilité: 'may', 'might', 'could' mpo na kozonga incertitude: 'This could lead to new treatments' (Oyo pouvais kozala na mibeko moko ya sante). 4) Mibeko ya kobongisa: 'however' (kasi), 'although' (ata), 'despite' (malgré), na structure ya makasi (ata + sujet + verbe, to despite + nom/-ing). 5) Vocabulaire ya académique na medecin: 'evidence', 'findings', 'symptoms', 'treatment', 'effective' vs. 'efficient'. Boye koluka kozala na anglais bazali kobenga répétition na kosalela pronoms relatifs: 'The patient whom the doctor treated...' (Mwana oyo medecin asili kosala ye...). Boye koluka kosala compréhension ya chiffres na pourcentages, oyo bazali na yango na mibeko yango.

concept_examples.text: The study shows that regular exercise can reduce the risk of heart disease.
concept_examples.translation: Etude esilisaka ete sport ya makasi ezali kosala risque ya maladi ya moto ya kolara.
concept_examples.phonetic: ðə ˈstʌdi ʃoʊz ðæt ˈrɛɡjələr ˈɛksərˌsaɪz kæn rɪˈdus ðə rɪsk əv hɑrt dɪˈziz.

concept_examples.text: Scientists have developed a new drug that might slow down the progression of Alzheimer's.
concept_examples.translation: Bato ya sayansi bazali kosala médicament moko ya sika oyo pouvais kozala na mbala ya kozala na Alzheimer.
concept_examples.phonetic: ˈsaɪəntɪsts hæv dɪˈvɛləpt ə nu drʌg ðæt maɪt sloʊ daʊn ðə prəˈɡrɛʃən əv ˈæltsˌhaɪmərz.

concept_examples.text: Although the results are promising, many experts remain cautious.
concept_examples.translation: Ata résultat ezali ya makasi, bato mingi ya sayansi bazali na makasi.
concept_examples.phonetic: ɔːlˈðoʊ ðə rɪˈzʌlts ɑr ˈprɑmɪsɪŋ ˈmɛni ˈɛkspɜrts rɪˈmeɪn ˈkɔʃəs.

concept_examples.text: The vaccine was tested on thousands of volunteers before being approved.
concept_examples.translation: Vaccin asili kosengeli na bato mingi ya kobenga yango tala na kozala na approbation.
concept_examples.phonetic: ðə vækˈsin wʌz ˈtɛstɪd ɑn ˈθaʊzəndz əv ˌvɑlənˈtɪrz bɪˈfɔr ˈbiɪŋ əˈpruvd.

common_error.wrong: Scientists has discovered a new cure for cancer.
common_error.correct: Scientists have discovered a new cure for cancer.
common_error.explanation: Erreur ezali kosala pona na espanyol tozali kobenga kobondela entre singulier na pluriel na conjugaison ya verbe 'haber' (hemos/han), kasi na anglais 'have' ezali kosalema na sujets pluriels ('scientists') na 'has' na sujets singuliers. Mpo na kozala na yango, boye koluka kobondela sujet na soki ezali pluriel, boye kosalela 'have'. Kosi na yango, boye koluka kozala na 'has' na troisième personne singulier (he/she/it).

examples.original: A recent study has shown that sleep deprivation affects cognitive function.
examples.phonetic: ə ˈrisənt ˈstʌdi hæz ʃoʊn ðæt slip ˌdɛprɪˈveɪʃən əˈfɛkts ˈkɑɡnɪtɪv ˈfʌŋkʃən.
examples.translation: Etude ya mbula moke esilisaka ete kozala na nguya ezali kosala fonction ya pensée.
examples.note: Kosalela temps présent parfait ('has shown') mpo na kobongisa résultat ya mbula moke na temps présent.

examples.original: Doctors recommend a balanced diet to prevent chronic diseases.
examples.phonetic: ˈdɑktərz ˌrɛkəˈmɛnd ə ˈbælənst ˈdaɪət tu prɪˈvɛnt ˈkrɑnɪk dɪˈzizəz.
examples.translation: Bato ya medecin bazali kolakisa dieta ya makasi mpo na kozala na maladi ya makasi.
examples.note: Verbe ya recommandation ('recommend') + nom; na espanyol tozali kosalela 'recomiendan' na objet direct.

examples.original: The hospital has implemented new protocols to reduce infection rates.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈhɑspɪtəl hæz ˈɪmpləˌmɛntɪd nu ˈproʊtəˌkɔlz tu rɪˈdus ɪnˈfɛkʃən reɪts.
examples.translation: Hôpital asili kosala mibeko miko mpo na kozala na taux ya infection.
examples.note: Temps présent parfait + 'to' + infinitif ya but, oyo ezali lokola 'para + infinitif' na espanyol.

examples.original: According to the latest research, there is considerable evidence that climate change affects public health.
examples.phonetic: əˈkɔrdɪŋ tu ðə ˈleɪtəst rɪˈsɜrtʃ, ðɛr ɪz kənˈsɪdərəbəl ˈɛvɪdəns ðæt ˈklaɪmət ʧeɪndʒ əˈfɛkts ˈpʌblɪk hɛlθ.
examples.translation: Na nzela ya recherche ya mbula moke, ezali preuve mingi ete changement ya climat ezali kosala sante ya publique.
examples.note: Expression 'according to' (na nzela ya) + structure 'there is' mpo na existence.

examples.original: The findings suggest that a new treatment could be effective against the virus.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈfaɪndɪŋz səˈdʒɛst ðæt ə nu ˈtritmənt kʊd bi ɪˈfɛktɪv əˈgɛnst ðə ˈvaɪrəs.
examples.translation: Résultat esilisaka ete traitement moko ya sika pouvais kozala na efficacité contre virus.
examples.note: Kosalela 'suggest' + 'that' + clause na verbe na subjonctif inversé (pouvais).

examples.original: However, more research is needed to confirm these results.
examples.phonetic: ˌhaʊˈɛvər, mɔr rɪˈsɜrtʃ ɪz ˈnidɪd tu kənˈfɜrm ðiz rɪˈzʌlts.
examples.translation: Kasi, ezali mpo na recherche mingi mpo na kozala na résultat yango.
examples.note: Mbeke 'however' na début ya phrase; na espanyol 'sin embargo' tozali kosalela coma na nsuka.

examples.original: Although vaccines are widely available, some populations still lack access to them.
examples.phonetic: ɔːlˈðoʊ vækˈsinz ɑr ˈwaɪdli əˈveɪləbəl, sʌm ˌpɑpjəˈleɪʃənz stɪl læk ˈæksɛs tu ðɛm.
examples.translation: Ata vaccins ezali na makasi, bato moko tozali na yango te.
examples.note: Kosalela 'although' mpo na concession, na nsuka ya clause, na sima coma.

examples.original: The government must invest more in public health to avoid future pandemics.
examples.phonetic: ðə ˈgʌvərnmənt mʌst ɪnˈvɛst mɔr ɪn ˈpʌblɪk hɛlθ tu əˈvɔɪd ˈfjuʧər pænˈdɛmɪks.
examples.translation: Gouvernement doit kosala sante ya publique mingi mpo na kozala na pandemie ya sika.
examples.note: Verbe modal 'must' mpo na obligation ya makasi; na espanyol tozali kosalela 'debe' to 'tiene que'.

examples.original: Despite the economic costs, the lockdown was necessary to save lives.
examples.phonetic: dɪˈspaɪt ði ˌɛkəˈnɑmɪk kɔsts, ðə ˈlɑkˌdaʊn wʌz ˈnɛsəˌsɛri tu seɪv laɪvz.
examples.translation: Malgré coût ya économie, confinement asili kozala na makasi mpo na kozala na vie.
examples.note: Structure 'despite + nom' (te clause), oyo ezali mbeke moko na 'although + clause'.

translations.ln: Mibeko ya sayansi na medecin oyo ezali makasi

title: Discussing Political and Social Issues / Discussion na nkombo ya mambu ya politika na ya sosété
bridge: Na español, tolingi kopesa makambo oyo tokoki kokanisa na yango na nkombo ya mambu ya politika ("Es importante que votemos"). Na anglais, na nsuka ya ba mot ya 'important', 'essential' to 'vital', tokosala 'subjunctive mood' (motsala ya bazo ya verbe) mpo na 'that' ezali na bosembo te: 'It's important that we vote'. Mbotámbu mosusu oyo ezali na ntina: na español tosalaka présent de subjonctif na ba phrases oyo ezali na 'cuando' ("Cuando haya elecciones"), kasi na anglais tosalaka présent simple: 'When there are elections'. Kolinga na kosala 'should' oyo baye bazali kosala español bazali kosala na bosembo te na ba structures oyo.
rule: Mpo na kosolola na nkombo ya politika na sosété na niveau B2, ezali na ntina kopesa: 1) 'Subjunctive mood' na nsuka ya ba mots ya ntina to ya bosembo (important, essential, vital, necessary): 'It's essential that the government act now'. Motsala ya verbe ezali ya bazo mpo na bankolo nyonso, na -s te na troisième personne. 2) Ba phrases ya temps oyo ezali na 'when', 'if' na conditionnels: tosalaka présent simple (futur te) na phrase oyo ezali na nsuka: 'When the election happens, we'll know the results'. 3) Ba expressions mpo na komonisa accord/désaccord: 'I strongly believe', 'I'm afraid I disagree', 'that's a valid point, but...'. 4) Kosala 'though' na nsuka ya phrase mpo na kopesa makambo mosusu: 'The policy seems good, though it's expensive'. 5) Ba différences ya vocabulaire: 'politics' ezali domaine oyo ezali ya mawa; 'policy' ezali mesure oyo ezali ya motoya. Na español 'política' ezali mpo na bankolo, oyo ezali cause ya ba erreurs.

concept_examples.text: It's crucial that every citizen vote in the upcoming election.
concept_examples.translation: Ezali na ntina mingi oyo chaque citoyen azua na ba élections oyo ezali koluka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪts ˈkruːʃəl ðət ˈɛvri ˈsɪtɪzən voʊt ɪn ði ˌʌpˈkʌmɪŋ ɪˈlɛkʃən/

concept_examples.text: When the government takes action, we will see significant changes.
concept_examples.translation: Tangá oyo gouvernement akotya ba mesures, tokoyebaka ba changements oyo ezali na ntina.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wɛn ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt teɪks ˈækʃən wi wɪl si sɪɡˈnɪfɪkənt ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz/

concept_examples.text: Many people argue that the new law is unfair, though it has some advantages.
concept_examples.translation: Bato mingi bazali koloba oyo loi mosu ezali ya mabe, kasi ezali na ba avantages mosusu.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈmɛni ˈpiːpəl ˈɑːrɡjuː ðæt ðə nuː lɔː ɪz ʌnˈfɛr ðoʊ ɪt hæz sʌm ədˈvæntɪdʒɪz/

concept_examples.text: It's essential that the media remain impartial during the campaign.
concept_examples.translation: Ezali na ntina mingi oyo ba médias de communication basala impartialité na campagne.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪts ɪˈsɛnʃəl ðət ðə ˈmiːdiə rɪˈmeɪn ɪmˈpɑːrʃəl ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə kæmˈpeɪn/

common_error.wrong: It's important that the government should do something about unemployment.
common_error.correct: It's important that the government do something about unemployment.
common_error.correct_alt: It's important for the government to do something about unemployment.
common_error.explanation: Na español, tolingi kosala 'debería' (should) na ba structures ya subjonctif: 'Es importante que el gobierno debería hacer algo'. Kasi na anglais, na nsuka ya ba expressions ya ntina, tosalaka subjonctif pur (na 'should' te): verbe na motsala naye ya bazo ('do'). Soki oyebi kosala 'should', tokosala structure mosusu: 'The government should do something', na 'that' te. Alternative na 'for + infinitif' ezali kokamba. Boyoka kozonga bankolo na ba constructions oyo.

levels.label: Agreeing and Disagreeing Politely
levels.translation: Kosala accord na désaccord na ngala

examples.original: I strongly believe that education should be a priority for every government.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈstrɔŋli bɪˈliːv ðæt ˌɛdʒuˈkeɪʃən ʃʊd biː ə praɪˈɔrɪti fɔːr ˈɛvri ˈɡʌvərnmənt/
examples.translation: Nakoki koloba na bosembo oyo éducation ezali na bosembo mpo na chaque gouvernement.
examples.note: Tosala 'strongly believe' mpo na kopesa opinion. Na español tosalaka 'creo firmemente' kasi boyoka: tosalaka 'I believe strongly' te, ezali ya mawa te.

examples.original: That's a valid point, but I'm afraid I have to disagree with you there.
examples.phonetic: /ðæts ə ˈvælɪd pɔɪnt bʌt aɪm əˈfreɪd aɪ hæv tə ˌdɪsəˈɡriː wɪð juː ðɛr/
examples.translation: Oyo ezali mot oyo ezali na bosembo, kasi nakoki koloba te oyo nazali na désaccord na yo na kati na oyo.
examples.note: Na español, 'me temo que' tosalaka na subjonctif: 'me temo que tenga que discrepar'. Na anglais tosalaka indicatif: 'I'm afraid I have to'. Tosalaka 'I am afraid that I must' te (ezali ya mawa mingi).

examples.original: I see what you mean, though I think we should look at the bigger picture.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ siː wʌt juː miːn ðoʊ aɪ θɪŋk wi ʃʊd lʊk æt ðə ˈbɪɡər ˈpɪktʃər/
examples.translation: Nakoki koyeba oyo oyebi koloba, kasi nakoki koloba oyo tokoki koluka na tableau oyo ezali ya mawa.
examples.note: 'Though' na nsuka ya phrase ezali ya mawa mingi na anglais ya conversation, ezali ya ngala na 'aunque' na español kasi na ordre oyo ezali ya mabe.

examples.original: If the government invested more in renewable energy, we could reduce pollution significantly.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ðə ˈɡʌvərnmənt ɪnˈvɛstɪd mɔːr ɪn rɪˈnuːəbəl ˈɛnərdʒi wi kʊd rɪˈduːs pəˈluːʃən sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli/
examples.translation: Soki gouvernement akotya mingi na énergie renouvelable, tokoki kosala pollution na ngala ya ntina.
examples.note: Na español tosalaka subjonctif (invirtiera) na conditionnel (podríamos). Na anglais tosalaka passé simple (invested) na 'could' + infinitif. Tosalaka 'If the government would invest' te – ezali erreur oyo ezali ya mawa.

examples.original: Unless we address the root causes of inequality, social unrest will continue.
examples.phonetic: /ʌnˈlɛs wi əˈdrɛs ðə ruːt ˈkɔːzɪz əv ˌɪnɪˈkwɑːləti ˈsoʊʃəl ʌnˈrɛst wɪl kənˈtɪnjuː/
examples.translation: Soki tokosala ba causes ya mawa ya inégalité te, malheur ya sosété akoyinda.
examples.note: Na español, 'a menos que' tosalaka subjonctif: 'abordemos'. Na anglais, tosalaka présent simple na nsuka ya 'unless' (oyo eleki 'if not'). Tosalaka futur te: 'Unless we will address'.

levels.label: Analyzing Causes and Consequences
levels.translation: Kosala analyse ya ba causes na ba conséquences

examples.original: The rise in unemployment is due to the lack of investment in key industries.
examples.phonetic: /ðə raɪz ɪn ˌʌnɪmˈplɔɪmənt ɪz duː tə ðə læk əv ɪnˈvɛstmənt ɪn kiː ˈɪndəstriz/
examples.translation: Augmentation ya chômage ezali na cause ya manque ya investissement na ba industries oyo ezali na ntina.
examples.note: Na español tosalaka 'se debe a'. Na anglais, 'is due to' ezali fixe. Tosalaka 'is because of' te (kasi tozali koyeba yango, ezali ya mawa te).

examples.original: A direct consequence of the new policy is that small businesses are struggling to survive.
examples.phonetic: /ə dɪˈrɛkt ˈkɒnsɪkwəns əv ðə nuː ˈpɒləsi ɪz ðæt smɔːl ˈbɪznəsɪz ɑːr ˈstrʌɡlɪŋ tə sərˈvaɪv/
examples.translation: Conséquence ya motoya ya politique mosu ezali oyo ba petites entreprises bazali na lutte mpo na kosala survie.
examples.note: Na español tosalaka 'las pequeñas empresas están luchando' – ezali ya ngala mingi. Boyoka: 'policy' eleki mesure oyo ezali ya motoya, te domaine ya politique ya mawa ('politics').

translations.ln: Mambu ya politika na ya sosété

title: Discussing Budgets and Investments / Kozonga yango kati na makobo
bridge: Na anglais, mibɔ́ mibɔ́ ya kozonga yango kati na mbongo basili na ndakisa mpe na mambu ya komonko. Kasi na ndakisa, 'spend' ezali na ntina ya kobomba, kasi 'invest' ezali na ntina ya ndakisa ya kopesa mbongo na elikya ya kobenga. Na español, tokosala na 'invertir' na mibɔ́ mibɔ́ mibali, kasi na anglais 'invest' ezali na ntina ya kopesa mbongo na elikya ya kobenga. Bosangani mosusu ezali ete na anglais tosalaka na mpeve ya ndakisa na mibɔ́ mibɔ́ yango: 'invest in', 'spend on', 'pay for'. Na español, mpeve ezali kosalema to ezali na ntina mosusu. Kolanda yango malamu mpo na kozwa ndakisa ya anglais.
rule: Mpo na kozonga yango kati na anglais na mibeko ya B2, boye mpe kobunda mpe kosala na mibɔ́ mibɔ́ mpe mibeko. Mibɔ́ mibɔ́ ya ndakisa: 'earn', 'save', 'spend', 'invest', 'borrow', 'lend', 'owe', 'pay off', 'set aside'. Na mibɔ́ mibɔ́ yango, mpeve ezali na ntina ya ndakisa: 'earn money from', 'save up for', 'spend on', 'invest in', 'borrow from', 'lend to'. Mitɔ́ndɔ́ ya ndakisa: 'budget', 'expenses', 'income', 'savings', 'debt', 'interest rate', 'stock market', 'investment portfolio'. Sala na temps présent mpo na mambu oyo tosalaka ntango nyonso ('I save 10% of my income'), mpe temps présent parfait mpo na mambu oyo tokoki kosala ('Have you ever invested in stocks?'). Mpo na mawa, sala na 'should' to 'ought to'. Kolanda malamu 'lend' mpe 'borrow': 'lend' ezali na ntina ya kopesa, 'borrow' ezali na ntina ya kozwa. Na español, 'prestar' ezali na mibɔ́ mibɔ́ mibali, kasi na anglais ezali mibɔ́ mibɔ́ misusu. Mpe, 'debt' ezali na ntina ya ndakisa ya mambu oyo tokoki kosala, kasi 'debts' ezali na ntina ya mambu oyo tokoki kosala ya ndakisa. Kolɛmbɛ 'money' ezali na ntina ya ndakisa ya mambu oyo tokoki kosala, kasi 'moneys' ezali na ntina ya mambu oyo tokoki kosala ya ndakisa.

concept_examples.text: I need to set aside some money for unexpected expenses.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali na mfunu ya kobomba mbongo mpo na mambu oyo ekoki kozala.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ niːd tə sɛt əˈsaɪd sʌm ˈmʌni fɔːr ˌʌnɪkˈspɛktɪd ɪkˈspɛnsɪz/

concept_examples.text: She invested in a diversified portfolio to reduce risk.
concept_examples.translation: Ye apesaki mbongo na portfolio moko mpo na kosala riske.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪnˈvɛstɪd ɪn ə daɪˈvɜːsɪfaɪd pɔːrtˈfoʊlioʊ tə rɪˈduːs rɪsk/

concept_examples.text: We're saving up for a down payment on a house.
concept_examples.translation: Tosalaka mbongo mpo na kopesa mbongo ya ntango ya ntango ya ntango.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wɪər ˈseɪvɪŋ ʌp fɔːr ə daʊn ˈpeɪmənt ɒn ə haʊs/

concept_examples.text: He borrowed money from the bank to start his business.
concept_examples.translation: Ye azwai mbongo na banque mpo na kosala komonko na ye.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː ˈbɒroʊd ˈmʌni frəm ðə bæŋk tə stɑːrt hɪz ˈbɪznəs/

common_error.wrong: I need to invert in a new computer.
common_error.correct: I need to invest in a new computer.
common_error.explanation: Bosɔangi ezali ete na español 'invertir' ezali na ntina ya kobomba mbongo na mambu oyo ezali na ntina, kasi na anglais 'invest' ezali na ntina ya kopesa mbongo na elikya ya kobenga. Mpo na kobomba mbongo na mambu oyo ezali na ntina, tosalaka na 'spend on' to 'invest in' soki oyo ezali na ntina ya kobenga. Mpe, kozonga ya 'invest' (na 'e' ya ndakisa) ezali na ntina mosusu na 'invert' (oyo ezali na ntina ya kozonga). Mpo na kosala bosɔangi, kolanda soki ozali na elikya ya kobenga; soki te, sala na 'spend'.

levels.label: Talking about spending and saving
levels.translation: Kozonga yango kati na mambu ya kobomba mpe kobenga

title: Expressing Abstract Ideas and Nuance / Komona mibeko ya mwa ngolu na mibeko ya ntango
bridge: Na español, tokomona mibeko ya ntango na mibeko ya mwa ngolu na subjuntivo na mikanda akomi 'es posible que' to 'me parece que'. Na anglais, koti oyeba mibeko ya moyo to kozonga ntango, bakosenga mpe vea ya mibeko oyo ezali na ntina te. Ndakisa ya likolo mwa mbeke ezali kozua mpe vea ya subjuntivo na anglais, oyo ezali te, kuna oyo toyebi kozanga mibeko ya mwa ngolu to ya ntango na mibeko ya mwa ngolu oyo ezali na ntina. Mpe tokoki kozala na likambo moko ya mawa koleka 'actualmente' (actually) to 'realizar' (to realize).
rule:
Koti oyokuma mibeko ya mwa ngolu na anglais na niveau B2, ezali ya ntina kozua:
1. Mivea ya mibeko koti kozanga na kozonga: 'might', 'could', 'may', 'must', 'can't'. Ndakisa: "She might be right" (Puede que ella tenga razón) - mwa ngolu ezali komonama na vea, te na subjuntivo.
2. Mikanda ya mibeko ya mwa ngolu na 'it': "It seems that...", "It is said that...", "It is believed that...". Na español tozua 'se dice', 'se cree', na anglais bazua mibeko ya mwa ngolu ya mwa ngolu.
3. Mivea ya mibeko ya mwa ngolu: 'apparently', 'presumably', 'totally', 'completely' koti kozanga.
4. Lisusu kati na 'actually' (na ngolu) na 'currently' (na ntango). 'Realize' ezali 'kozua', te 'realizar'.
5. Koti kozanga mibeko: 'I would argue that...', 'I tend to think that...', 'From my perspective...'.
6. Tokoki kozala na likambo moko ya mawa na 'suggest' na 'recommend' + that + mibeko ya mwa ngolu (na subjuntivo te): "I suggest that he go" (te 'goes').
7. Mibeko ya mwa ngolu 'would' koti kozanga: "If I were you, I would..."

common_error.explanation: Likambo ezali kozala na mibeko ya mwa ngolu to ya mibeko ya mwa ngolu ya español. title: Discussing Art and Culture / Kozonga ntama na ntango
bridge: Na espanyol, tozali kozonga ntango oyo ezali na sima ya indicativo mpo na kozonga mikanda ya zoba na ntango oyo ezali na sima ya parfait mpo na makambo oyo tokoki kozonga na ntango ya nsuka (Asali koyeba...?). Na anglais, 'present perfect' (nalukaki) ezali kozanga mingi mpo na makambo oyo tokoki kozonga na boma na kozonga oyo ezali na sima ya nsuka, mpe 'past simple' ezali kozanga mpo na makambo oyo tokoki kozonga na ntango oyo ezali na sima ya nsuka. Mokolo moko ya ntina: na anglais, bato oyo bazali na nkenda (amazing, stunning) bazali kozanga liboso ya bato oyo bazali na nkenda ya makasi, kaka na espanyol, kasi boye na nzela ya kozanga bato: na anglais tozali kozanga 'a beautiful old painting' te 'an old beautiful painting'. Mpe, na anglais tozali kozanga ndaku 'the' mpo na kozonga mokolo moko oyo tokoki kozonga to kozanga, mpe na espanyol tozali kozanga yango ntango moko.
rule:
Mpo na kozonga zoba na ntango na anglais na niveau B2, boye ozali na makasi:
- Kozanga ntango oyo ezali na sima ya présent mpo na kozonga mikanda ya zoba: 'The painting depicts...'
- Kozanga ntango oyo ezali na sima ya présent parfait mpo na makambo oyo tokoki kozonga: 'I have visited the Prado Museum.'
- Kozanga ntango oyo ezali na sima ya passé simple mpo na makambo oyo tokoki kozonga na ntango oyo ezali na sima ya nsuka: 'She painted this in 1990.'
- Bato: nzela ya kozanga ya kozanga (nkenda, nguya, mokolo, makasi, boye) na kozanga 'so' na 'such' mpo na kozanga.
- Kozanga makambo oyo tokoki kozonga: 'In my view...', 'It strikes me as...'
- Verbos modales mpo na kozanga: 'It might be a fake.', 'It could represent freedom.'

common_error.explanation: Ndakisa ezali kozanga 'present perfect' na mokolo moko oyo ezali na sima ya nsuka kaka 'yesterday'. Na anglais, soki ozali kozanga mokolo moko oyo ezali na sima ya nsuka, boye ozali na makasi kozanga 'past simple'. 'Present perfect' ezali kozanga mpo na makambo oyo tokoki kozonga na mokolo moko oyo ezali na sima ya nsuka to na mokolo moko oyo ezali na sima ya nsuka. Mpo na kozanga yango, boye ozali na makasi: soki ozali kozanga 'yesterday', 'last year', 'in 1990', kozanga 'past simple'. Soki ozali kozanga 'ever', 'never', 'already', kozanga 'present perfect'.

title: Problem-solving discussions / Discussion po kosala makasi
bridge: Na espanyol, po kozwa makasi, tozali kozinga mbula ndenge ya subjonctif to bangogo ndenge 'podríamos' mpe '¿qué tal si...?'. Kasi na anglais, bazali kozinga likambo mosusu ya modal mpe kondisyonel oyo ezali na ndenge moke. Molongo moko ezali kopesa 'si yo sería' kasi ezali na ndenge 'if I were' (kondisyonel ya liboso). Mpe na anglais, bazali kozinga 'should' mpe 'ought to' po kozwa makasi, kasi na espanyol, 'deberías' ezali na ndenge moko. Kolinga motoya na ndenge oyo bangogo ya kondisyonel ezali kosalema mpe ndenge oyo 'would' ezali kosalema na bangogo ya liboso.
rule:
Po kozwa makasi na anglais na niveau B2, tozali kozinga bangogo ya kondisyonel mpe modal ndenge eleki: 
1. **Kondisyonel ya liboso** (hypothetic): 'If + passé simple, would + verbe base'. Molongo: 'If we had more time, we could finish the project.' Ezali kozwa likambo oyo ezali na makasi te. 
2. **Kondisyonel ya mibale** (passé hypothetic): 'If + past perfect, would have + participe passé'. Molongo: 'If we had known earlier, we would have solved it.' Po kozwa likambo oyo esili makasi te. 
3. **Modal po kozwa makasi**: 'should', 'ought to', 'had better' + verbe base. 'Had better' ezali na makasi mingi mpe ezali kozwa likambo oyo ekoki kozala na makasi. 
4. **Bangogo po kozwa idée**: 'What about...?', 'How about...?', 'Why don't we...?', 'Could we...?', 'Maybe we should...'. 
5. **Bangogo po kozwa option**: 'On the one hand... on the other hand...', 'The advantage is...', 'The downside is...', 'It might work because...'. 
6. **Kozwa accord mpe désaccord**: 'I see your point, but...', 'That sounds reasonable, however...', 'I'm not convinced that...'. 
Boyi kozinga 'would' na bangogo ya 'if' (molongo moko ya bato oyo bazali kozala na espanyol).

concept_examples.text: If I were you, I would talk to the manager.
concept_examples.translation: Soki nazali yo, nakotuna na chef.

concept_examples.text: We could try a different approach.

concept_examples.text: Why don't we brainstorm some solutions?
concept_examples.translation: Ndenge nini tosalaka idée mibale?

concept_examples.text: The advantage is that it saves time, but the downside is the cost.

concept_examples.phonetic: /ði ədˈvæntɪdʒ ɪz ðæt ɪt seɪvz taɪm, bʌt ðə ˈdaʊnsaɪd ɪz ðə kɔːst/

common_error.wrong: If I would have more money, I would buy a new car.
common_error.correct: If I had more money, I would buy a new car.
common_error.correct_alt: If I had more money, I could buy a new car.
common_error.explanation: Molongo ezali kosalema na ntina ete na espanyol tozali kozinga 'si yo tendría' (to 'si yo tuviera'), kasi na anglais, na kondisyonel ya liboso, bangogo ya 'if' ezali kozinga passé simple (te 'would'). 'Would' ezali kozalaka na bangogo ya liboso. Boyi kopesa na ndenge moko. Kolinga motoya: 'If + past simple, would + verbe'.

examples.original: How about we set a deadline?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ əˈbaʊt wiː sɛt ə ˈdɛdlaɪn/
examples.translation: Ndenge nini tosalaka date ya limite?
examples.note: Kozinga 'How about' + sujet + verbe na présent po kozwa makasi. Ezali na ndenge moke koleka 'What about'.

examples.original: Maybe we should invest in better software.
examples.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi wiː ʃʊd ɪnˈvɛst ɪn ˈbɛtər ˈsɒftwɛər/
examples.translation: Mbala mosusu tokoki kosala logiciel moke malamu.
examples.note: 'Should' po kozwa makasi. Na B2, tokoki kozinga 'I think we should' po kopesa ndenge moke.

examples.original: Could we ask for an extension?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd wiː ɑːsk fɔːr ən ɪkˈstɛnʃən/
examples.translation: Tokoki kozwa délai moke?
examples.note: 'Could' ezali na ndenge moke koleka 'can' po kozwa makasi.

examples.original: On one hand, it's cheaper, but on the other hand, it's less reliable.

examples.translation: Na mboka moke, ezali ya prix mingi, kasi na mboka moke moke, ezali ya qualité mingi te.
examples.note: Bangogo ya liboso po kozwa avantage mpe inconvenient na discussion ya ndenge moke.

examples.original: The main drawback is that it requires training.
examples.phonetic: /ðə meɪn ˈdrɔːbæk ɪz ðæt ɪt rɪˈkwaɪərz ˈtreɪnɪŋ/
examples.translation: Inconvenient ya liboso ezali ete ezali na formation.
examples.note: 'Drawback' ezali bangogo moke ya 'disadvantage'. Kozinga yango na contexte ya professionnel.

examples.original: I'm not convinced that this will solve the issue.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm nɒt kənˈvɪnst ðæt ðɪs wɪl sɒlv ði ˈɪʃuː/
examples.translation: Nazali na makasi te ete likambo oyo ekoki kosala makasi.
examples.note: Kozwa scepticisme na 'I'm not convinced' + 'that'.

examples.original: If we all agree, we can move forward.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wiː ɔːl əˈɡriː, wiː kæn muːv ˈfɔːrwərd/
examples.translation: Soki nionso tozali d'accord, tokoki kozala na avancer.
examples.note: Kondisyonel ya liboso po kozwa likambo oyo ezali na makasi. Na B2, kozinga kondisyonel na verbe modal.

examples.original: Would you be open to a compromise?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd juː biː ˈoʊpən tə ə ˈkɒmprəmaɪz/

examples.note: Kozinga 'would' na question ya ndenge moke po kozwa négociation.

examples.original: I think we need to find a middle ground.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk wiː niːd tə faɪnd ə ˈmɪdl ɡraʊnd/
examples.translation: Nazali na makasi ete tokoki kozwa point ya milieu.
examples.note: Bangogo ya ndenge moke oyo bazali kozinga mingi na réunion. 'Middle ground' = point ya milieu.

examples.original: So we're all on the same page?
examples.phonetic: /soʊ wɪər ɔːl ɒn ðə seɪm peɪdʒ/
examples.translation: Tokomi na ndenge moko nionso?
examples.note: 'On the same page' ezali kozwa ete tozali d'accord to nazali na compréhension moko.

title: Talking about Goals and Ambitions / Kozonga ntalo na makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango
bridge: Na español, tozali kozonga ntalo na makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango na ntango a présent oyo ezali na indicatif to futuro perifrástico (ir a + infinitivo), kasi na anglais ezali mpenza kozonga yango na bango mpo na kozonga makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango, mpo na kozonga makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango, mpo na kozonga makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango, mpo na kozonga makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango, mpo na kozonga makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango, mpo na kozonga makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango. Kasi tozali na bosongi mpo na kozonga 'would like' (me gustaría) oyo ezali kozonga makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango na ntango a formel to hypothétique, oyo na español ezali kozonga 'quiero'. Bosongi moko mpenza: na anglais tozali kozonga gerundios (-ing) na nse ya prépositions na verbes mpo na 'look forward to', kasi na español tozali kozonga infinitivos.
rule: Mpo na kozonga ntalo na makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango na anglais na niveau B2, tozali kozonga bango mpo na kozonga makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango: 1) 'be going to + infinitivo' mpo na makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango (I’m going to start a business). 2) 'will + infinitivo' mpo na makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango to prédictions (I’ll do my best). 3) 'would like + infinitivo' to 'would love + infinitivo' mpo na makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango (I’d like to improve my English). 4) Verbes mpo na 'hope', 'plan', 'intend', 'expect' oyo ezali na infinitivo (I hope to travel, I plan to save money). 5) Expressions na gerundio na nse ya prépositions: 'look forward to + -ing', 'be interested in + -ing'. 6) Premier condicional mpo na makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango oyo ezali na condition: 'If I study hard, I’ll pass the exam'. Bosongi mpo na kozonga yango: kozonga 'to' na infinitivos, kozonga infinitivo na nse ya prépositions (correcto: 'I’m good at learning'), na kozonga 'will' na présent mpo na kozonga makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango oyo ezali na fixe. Kasi tozali na bosongi mpo na 'hope' oyo ezali na présent simple mpo na futuro (I hope I get the job).

concept_examples.text: I’m planning to start my own business next year.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali kozonga mpo na kobanga yango mpo na koboma bisness na ngai na mwaka oyo ezali kozonga.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈplænɪŋ tə stɑːrt maɪ oʊn ˈbɪznəs nekst jɪr/

concept_examples.text: I’d like to improve my public speaking skills.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali kozonga mpo na kobanga yango mpo na kobikisa biloko na ngai mpo na kozonga na public.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk tə ɪmˈpruːv maɪ ˈpʌblɪk ˈspiːkɪŋ skɪlz/

concept_examples.text: If I work hard, I’ll achieve my goals.
concept_examples.translation: Soki nazali kosala makasi, nazali kobanga makambo na ngai.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ wɜːrk hɑːrd aɪl əˈtʃiːv maɪ ɡoʊlz/

concept_examples.text: I’m looking forward to graduating from university.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali na eloko mpo na kobanga yango na université.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈlʊkɪŋ ˈfɔːrwərd tə ˈɡrædʒueɪtɪŋ frəm ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti/

common_error.wrong: I look forward to graduate from university.
common_error.correct: I look forward to graduating from university.
common_error.correct_alt: I’m looking forward to graduating from university.
common_error.explanation: Bosongi ezali mpo na kozonga 'deseando + infinitivo' (nazali kozonga mpo na kobanga yango). Na anglais, na nse ya 'look forward to', préposition 'to' ezali na gerundio (-ing), kasi ezali na infinitivo. Ezali bosongi mpo na bato oyo bazali kozonga español. Boye: soki 'to' ezali préposition (kasi ezali na infinitivo), ezali na -ing.

levels.label: Expressing Intentions
levels.translation: Kozonga makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango

examples.original: I’m going to start a new hobby this summer.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə stɑːrt ə nuː ˈhɑːbi ðɪs ˈsʌmər/
examples.translation: Nazali kozonga mpo na kobanga yango na été oyo ezali kozonga.
examples.note: Tozali kozonga 'be going to' mpo na makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango oyo ezali na fixe.

examples.original: I intend to apply for that job in London.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ɪnˈtend tə əˈplaɪ fɔːr ðæt dʒɑːb ɪn ˈlʌndən/
examples.translation: Nazali na eloko mpo na kobanga yango na Londres.
examples.note: Verbe 'intend' ezali na 'to + infinitivo'. Ezali mpenza na formel na 'going to'.

examples.original: I’m hoping to save enough money for a trip.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈhoʊpɪŋ tə seɪv ɪˈnʌf ˈmʌni fɔːr ə trɪp/
examples.translation: Nazali kozonga mpo na kobanga yango mpo na koboma bisness na ngai.
examples.note: Na 'hope' tozali kozonga présent continu mpo na kozonga eloko oyo tolingi kobanga yango.

examples.original: I plan to learn Spanish next year.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ plæn tə lɜːrn ˈspænɪʃ nekst jɪr/
examples.translation: Nazali kozonga mpo na kobanga yango na español na mwaka oyo ezali kozonga.
examples.note: 'Plan to' ezali na infinitivo na tozali kozonga mpo na makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango oyo ezali na concret.

levels.label: Setting Conditions
levels.translation: Kozonga makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango

examples.original: If I get a promotion, I’ll buy a house.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ ɡet ə prəˈmoʊʃən aɪl baɪ ə haʊs/
examples.translation: Soki nazali kobanga yango, nazali koboma maison.
examples.note: Premier condicional na anglais: if + présent, will + infinitivo. Tozali kozonga futuro na clause na 'if'.

examples.original: Unless I start saving now, I won’t be able to travel.
examples.phonetic: /ənˈles aɪ stɑːrt ˈseɪvɪŋ naʊ aɪ woʊnt bi ˈeɪbəl tə ˈtrævəl/
examples.translation: Soki nazali kobanga yango, nazali koboma bisness na ngai.
examples.note: 'Unless' ezali mpo na 'a moins que' na ezali na négation, kasi tozali kozonga 'not' na clause oyo.

examples.original: Provided that I finish my thesis, I’ll graduate in June.
examples.phonetic: /prəˈvaɪdɪd ðæt aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃ maɪ ˈθiːsɪs aɪl ˈɡrædʒueɪt ɪn dʒuːn/
examples.translation: Soki nazali kobanga yango, nazali koboma bisness na ngai na juin.
examples.note: 'Provided that' ezali mpenza na formel na 'if' na ezali mpo na 'siempre que'.

examples.original: Once I have enough experience, I’ll start my own company.
examples.phonetic: /wʌns aɪ hæv ɪˈnʌf ɪkˈspɪriəns aɪl stɑːrt maɪ oʊn ˈkʌmpəni/
examples.translation: Soki nazali kobanga yango, nazali koboma bisness na ngai.
examples.note: Tozali kozonga 'once' + présent mpo na futuro, oyo ezali mpo na 'cuando'.

levels.label: Discussing Ambitions
levels.translation: Kozonga makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango

examples.original: I would love to become a successful writer.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd lʌv tə bɪˈkʌm ə səkˈsesfəl ˈraɪtər/
examples.translation: Nazali kozonga mpo na kobanga yango mpo na koboma bisness na ngai.
examples.note: 'Would love to' ezali mpenza na enfático na 'would like to' na tozali kozonga mpo na makambo oyo tolingi kobanga yango oyo ezali na fort.

examples.original: My dream is to travel around the world and help communities.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ driːm ɪz tə ˈtrævəl əˈraʊnd ðə wɜːrld ənd help kəˈmjuːnətiz/
examples.translation: Eloko na ngai ezali mpo na kobanga yango na monde na kozonga bato.
examples.note: Soki eloko ezali sujet, tozali kozonga 'is to + infinitivo' mpo na kozonga eloko oyo tolingi kobanga yango.

examples.original: I’m working towards becoming a certified coach.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈwɜːrkɪŋ təˈwɔːrdz bɪˈkʌmɪŋ ə ˈsɜːrtɪfaɪd koʊtʃ/
examples.translation: Nazali kozonga mpo na kobanga yango mpo na koboma bisness na ngai.
examples.note: Expression 'work towards' ezali na gerundio mpo na 'towards' ezali préposition.

examples.original: In ten years’ time, I hope to have my own practice.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn ten jɪrz taɪm aɪ hoʊp tə hæv maɪ oʊn ˈpræktɪs/
examples.translation: Na mwaka oyo ezali kozonga, nazali kozonga mpo na kobanga yango.
examples.note: Tozali kozonga 'in + periodo + time' mpo na kozonga eloko oyo tolingi kobanga yango.
